title: When a monster has you
summary: Being grabbed is a situation R.E.P.O. plans for: the game defines a monster built around holding a player, and reviving a crew member depends on carrying the right item.
body: One of the monsters is built around latching onto a player rather than chasing and leaving, so being held is a state the game expects you to be in.
Getting free is not a free action: reviving a crew member uses a dedicated item, so whether a rescue is possible depends on what the crew brought.
Fighting back uses separate weapon objects, which is why a crew that brought weapons has an answer that a crew carrying only loot does not.
What this entry does not tell you: how long a hold lasts, how much damage follows, or the reach of any weapon. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: A monster exists whose behaviour is built around holding a player.
Reviving a crew member requires a dedicated item.
Fighting back uses separate weapon objects.
